what: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
text: Retrieves sites via get_site_summary(), extracts longitude/latitude geometry, arranges de-duplicates records, optionally drops organisation fields, computes WGS84 (EPSG:4326) bounding box using geodesic buffer.

title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
code: get_bbox(   tier_id,   buffer_m = 10,   drop_org_cols = TRUE,   return_bbox_as = c("bbox", "list", "polygon") )

title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
text: tier_id Character (coercible). ReefCloud Tier ID. buffer_m Numeric, non-negative. Buffer distance meters around sites' convex hull computing bbox. Default 10 (meters). drop_org_cols Logical. Drop org_name org_id present. Default TRUE. return_bbox_as Character. One : "bbox" (default): returns sf bbox object. "list": named list xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax. "polygon": buffered hull sf polygon (WGS84).

title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
text: list : sites: sf object cleaned sites including lon, lat bbox: bbox/list/polygon depending return_bbox_as

title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
text: sites WGS84, transformed EPSG:4326 processing. function expands bbox \(buffer_m / 111000\) degrees. avoid zero-area bboxes identical/near-identical site coordinates, tiny minimal expansion applied hull area zero.

title: Get Cleaned Sites and a Buffered WGS84 Bounding Box for a Tier — get_bbox
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Basic: fetch, clean, and get a small buffered bbox out <- get_bbox(tier_id = 1705, buffer_m = 10) out$sites out$bbox  # Supply a year to the underlying API: out <- get_bbox(tier_id = "1705", buffer_m = 10,                                 return_bbox_as = "list")  out$bbox  # named list xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax } # }
